profile.description: I'm a software engineer passionate about DevOps and fullstack development, building scalable systems and smooth deployment workflows.

fullstack.title: Full-Stack Web Development
fullstack.description: I build responsive and user-friendly web applications using modern frameworks like React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. My focus is on creating seamless user experiences and efficient front-end architectures.

devops.title: DevOps & CI/CD Automation
devops.description: I implement robust CI/CD pipelines and automate infrastructure provisioning using tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform. My goal is to streamline development workflows and enhance deployment efficiency.

ai.title: AI Tools & Workflow Automation
ai.description: I develop AI-powered tools and automate workflows to boost productivity. Leveraging machine learning models and APIs, I create solutions that simplify complex tasks and improve operational efficiency.

api.title: API Development & Integration
api.description: I design and develop scalable RESTful APIs using FastAPI and Node.js. I also specialize in integrating third-party services to enhance application functionality and performance.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: No blog posts yet, but I’m planning to start writing soon.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a dedicated software engineer with a passion for creating efficient and scalable solutions. With expertise in both full-stack development and DevOps, I thrive on building robust systems and automating workflows to enhance productivity.

tinyterms.title: Tiny Terms
tinyterms.description: A minimal terminal emulator built with React and Tailwind CSS, designed for simplicity and ease of use. It offers essential terminal functionalities in a clean and user-friendly interface.

solpluse.title: SolPluse
solpluse.description: A Solana Wallet activity checker built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. It allows users to monitor and track their wallet activities on the Solana blockchain.

detoxify.title: Detoxify Api Service
detoxify.description: A RESTful API service built with FastAPI that leverages the Detoxify model to analyze and classify text for toxicity. The service provides endpoints for clients to submit text data and receive toxicity scores, facilitating content moderation and safe communication.

reactminisearch.title: React Mini Search
reactminisearch.description: A lightweight search component built with React that enables efficient searching and filtering of data sets. It provides a simple and intuitive interface for users to quickly find relevant information within large collections of data.

0docs.title: 0Docs (Ongoing)
0docs.description: An Opensource Documentation Nextjs Template built with Tailwind CSS. It provides a clean and organized layout for creating and hosting project documentation, making it easy for developers to share information about their software projects.

freelancer.description: Completed a Software Engineering Internship at Ethronics, where I designed and developed a scalable RESTful API, built a responsive and SEO-friendly website using React and Tailwind CSS, and collaborated with the engineering team to enhance system reliability and performance.

internship.description: Completed a Software Engineering Internship at Ethronics, where I designed and developed a scalable RESTful API, built a responsive and SEO-friendly website using React and Tailwind CSS, and collaborated with the engineering team to enhance system reliability and performance.

internship2.description: Built and integrated backend services in Go and Node.js within a production microservices system, implementing core business logic and authentication workflows alongside senior engineers. Collaborated with frontend and backend teams to integrate APIs, connect frontend applications with backend services, and deliver secure, production-ready features, with a particular focus on authentication, authorization, and seamless frontend–backend integration.
